method.source: Codex session log ~/.codex/sessions/2026/09/03/rollout-2026-09-03T12-04-35-*.jsonl, response_item and token_count events inside each batch's operator-prompt-to-completion span; Claude finish phase from its own session log. Counts are reconstructed after the fact, not instrumented.

fields.modelTurns: assistant messages in the span (visible replies; reasoning items counted separately)
fields.toolCalls: function calls of any kind (shell, patch, Figma)
fields.figmaCalls: occurrences of use_figma plus download_assets/upload_assets in tool-call arguments (approximate: a wrapper script naming the tool twice counts twice)
fields.screenshots: occurrences of get_screenshot in tool-call arguments
fields.contextLoadedBytes: bytes of the startup reading set the batch was told to read: legacy = CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md + OPERATORS.md + design-system-schema.json at that commit; lean = CLAUDE.md + workflow/README.md + protocol.json + manifest.json + generated contract
fields.peakInputTokens: largest last_token_usage.input_tokens in the span (Codex context window; includes earlier session history)
fields.corrections: assistant messages in the span that mention correcting, fixing, catching, retrying, or stopping; the batch record's own correction count is given where it exists
